rows.ARS:
Pink blend Floribunda.
Registration name: MEIgekanu
Exhibition name: La Sevillana ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Marie-Louise (Louisette) Meilland (Paolino) (1920-1987) (France, 1969).
Introduced in France by URS (Universal Rose Selection)-Meilland in 1977 as 'La Sevillana'.
Introduced in Australia by Ross Roses in 1988 as 'La Sevillana'.
rows.Bloom: Vermilion to orange-red. Mild fragrance. 15 petals. Average diameter 3". Semi-double (9-16 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Semi-glossy, bronze-green foliage.

Height: 4'11" to 5'5" (150 to 165cm). Width: 5' (150cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 5b through 9b. Can be used for ground cover. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
